title: Docker & Containers
blurb: Containers from the kernel up: namespaces, cgroups and layered images, Dockerfiles and the build cache, registries, storage, Compose, health checks, observability, Swarm and Kubernetes, safe upgrades, secrets, CI builds, multi-architecture images, security hardening, ML/GPU images and worked interview answers.
sources: Elton Stoneman, Learn Docker in a Month of Lunches (Manning, 2020), ch. 1-21
Official docs: docs.docker.com (Dockerfile reference, Compose file reference, Engine, Build, Swarm)
Official docs: kubernetes.io, prometheus.io, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, astral.sh/uv
